Title: Tutorial: Return the Medical Supplies
Descriptions: The Captain sent you? Trapped? What? No, I don't want that rifle, and I told him I would be fine! Why am I out here? I'm studying methods for making myself invisible to the infected. It would give us a huge advantage in this fight! I've either made a major breakthrough, or I'm infected and about to turn! Its exciting! I'll know for sure in a few days! I can't wait to share my research! Well... If any of my colleagues from university are still alive that is. Either way, tell the Captain not to send more people. Take these medical supplies I collected back to him.
